summary: ONE_SEARCH_ATTENTION_VOLUME_PREREGISTRATION_IDEA_READY — One idea skeleton only: LAGGED_FINALIZED_WEEKLY_SEARCH_ATTENTION_X_PREDECISION_VOLUME_INNOVATION_DRA_ADMISSION_V1. For UTC day D, use only the two latest finalized public weekly search-attention vintages received before the entry cutoff; define positive attention as their positive log change. Interact it with a positive residual from a frozen expanding one-step log-volume model estimated only through D-2 and evaluated on complete D-1 volume. Admit otherwise-eligible entries from the frozen offline DRA V1 parent only when both terms are positive. The primary diagnostic horizon is the next complete UTC day. The equal-capital comparator is the identical parent with identical entries, accounting, fees, adverse-slippage assumptions and valuation boundary but without this admission rule. This differs from the excluded DAILY_VOLUME_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN family because raw volume or a 20-day ratio cannot admit an entry, search must temporally precede the independently modelled volume innovation, and the volume residual uses no 20-day median. Expected later direction is higher fee-adjusted total PnL and non-increasing maximum drawdown, but immediate PnL and drawdown effects are zero and every economic or predictive effect remains MISSING_PROOF.

checks.name: PRIMARY_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_MATRIX
checks.evidence: Nasir, Huynh, Nguyen and Duong use weekly 2013–2017 data, VAR, Granger, copula and nonparametric methods; they report short-run search-to-return evidence, while the volume relation is weaker and not persistent. De Luca and Montanino report contemporaneous upper–upper and lower–upper return-volume tail dependence, so high volume is nondirectional. Shelton tests in-sample and out-of-sample regressions with robust inference and reports limited or absent out-of-sample prediction for popular Bitcoin predictors.

checks.name: SEARCH_ATTENTION_LEAD_LAG_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: The skeleton requires finalized weekly attention vintages received before decision and a separately observed complete prior-day volume innovation. Current-week, revised-after-decision, contemporaneous or return-reactive search values are ineligible. Search must precede volume and entry; volume alone cannot admit.

checks.name: IN_SAMPLE_VS_OUT_OF_SAMPLE_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: Primary literature establishes plausibility, not transferable prediction. Weekly historical association, Granger ordering and copula dependence cannot prove daily DRA entry value. Shelton's weak out-of-sample evidence is treated as mandatory counterevidence; a later clean forward test is required without reinterpretation.

Close if search fails to lead after lagged-return controls, reverse return-to-search ordering dominates, weekly evidence does not survive the frozen daily mapping, the interaction lacks incremental value, support or concentration gates fail, or clean forward results do not confirm direction.

uncertainty: Public search-attention publication latency, revision behavior and point-in-time historical-vintage availability are not proven; inability to seal these prospectively closes the idea.
The 2013–2017 weekly search study may not transfer to daily DRA decisions, later regimes or current market structure.
The source study's search-to-volume estimate was weaker than its search-to-return evidence, and reported relationships did not persist in the long run.
Copula tail dependence is contemporaneous and nondirectional; it cannot establish that volume predicts returns or that the proposed interaction is causal.
Popular Bitcoin predictors showed weak out-of-sample performance in the counterevidence study; attention-specific incremental forward prediction remains untested.
Exact support thresholds, source contract, timestamp mapping, expanding volume model specification and all economic gates must be frozen before any outcome access.
Fee-adjusted PnL, realized and unrealized PnL, maximum drawdown, fills, slippage, capacity, breadth, holding age, terminal inventory, causality and clean forward/OOS value remain MISSING_PROOF.
Local executable task/result schema validation remains MISSING_PROOF because python was unavailable; Manager authoritative post-return validation is still required.
